candidate.title: TruSeq PCR Free
candidate.scope: The single TruSeq PCR Free product-preparation schematic supplied on the Illumina poster: double-stranded DNA through fractionation and size selection, end repair and phosphorylation, A-overhang formation, adaptor addition and ligation, ending at a library ready for cluster generation. This is a schematic-level DNA library architecture, not a versioned complete kit protocol. The retained insert represents fragments of the starting DNA; the diagram specifies neither a biological specimen or selected genomic target nor a sequencing or analysis workflow. Its PCR-free title and direct ligation-to-product route show no library PCR operation. The drawing does not establish index sequences, number of distinct indices or a read configuration.

operations.information_effect: The retained DNA fragments carry portions of the starting DNA sequence. Size selection restricts which fragments enter the downstream library.

operations.label: Adaptor ligation
